name: @kira905/dsh-router-toolkit
description: Controlled verbs for an orchestrator-style DSH main session: it issues commands but never executes them. A distilled minimal skeleton (message delivery with two gates, three health checks, an agent-preset template, vision-gap ranking, a hand-off header compressor, an optional vision pointer on digest rows, a mechanical per-workstream digest, stale-attention bookkeeping that fails open, a four-bucket "is this workstream idle" judgement, a vision-directory index, and an optional web plugin for an explicit wrap-up-and-compact button). Zero third-party runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: node test/run-self-test.mjs && node test/run-unit-tests.mjs && node test/test-router-act.mjs && node test/test-yearring-index.mjs && node test/test-router-reset-plugin.mjs && node router-lazy.mjs --selftest
